question: Welche Regierungsebene bildet den unteren Teil des gestapelten Balkendiagramms im linken Panel?
question_english: Which level of government forms the bottom part of the stacked bar chart in the left panel?
model_answer: Based on the legend and the context of German government levels, the bottom blue part of the stacked bar chart represents the federal level, or "**Bund**". Although the label is partially obscured, it forms the standard group of territorial authorities alongside "Länder" (states) and "Gemeinden" (municipalities).
